Summary: This update adds stricter setup enforcement, multi-platform (OpenClaw/Hermes) support, and explicit invocation requirements.

- Enforces an absolute trigger constraint: this skill must be invoked before calling any Gecho MCP tools for TikTok-related tasks.
- Adds setup instructions and command examples for both OpenClaw and Hermes agent environments.
- Requires agents to check readiness and stop with guidance if the official Gecho MCP tools are not available, disallowing fallback to terminal, browser, or web scrapers.
- Clarifies guidance to never improvise installation or verification steps; only specific commands from the instructions may be provided.
- Improves setup awareness and troubleshooting instructions for ClawHub, OpenClaw, and Hermes scenarios.

**Summary:** Major update focused on improving user guidance and clarifying prerequisites. Official installation guide now external.  

- Consolidated user and agent setup steps, moving most technical instructions and troubleshooting to a linked README.
- Added clear step-by-step onboarding with commands for OpenClaw-based deployments.
- Improved error handling and first-use instructions for both direct users and agents.
- Introduced a new section for most common use cases and recommended starter prompts.
- Added explicit mention of `check_insight_status` tool for async job retrieval.
- Provided official Discord and WeChat links for real-time community support.

Initial release of the TikTok Search skill – professional TikTok keyword search and extraction tool.

- Supports automated TikTok search and metadata extraction through a Chrome extension and Node.js.
- Provides two main tools: `tiktok_search` (video metadata) and `tiktok_insight` (trend/business analysis).
- Enforces strict execution rules: one tool call per turn, no retries, no fallbacks, and robust error handling with explicit reporting.
- Returns concise summaries in chat; saves full results to a specified local path.
- Includes step-by-step usage instructions, error troubleshooting guidelines, and highlights all operational constraints.
